EllipsesOnLayered

#mathart #mathober #mathober1 #dataviz #perimeters #geometry #ellipses  #livecoding

For Code/More Images: https://blog.illestpreacha.com/mathober2026-ellispes 

For my 1st sketch of #Mathober2026 coded in #Python, EllipsesOnLayered takes the prompt of “Perimeter of Ellipses” and explores these shapes with perimeters that are overexposed.

#Poetry

The Perimeter is layered, slightly fractured
But is still managing to maintain
The elements that it contains 
With the pixelation that it captured 
There are more ellipses to gain
